# SpeedyIndex MCP

> Unofficial Bun/TypeScript stdio MCP server. This source branch implements nine tools: get_balance, list_tasks, get_task_status, get_task_report, guarded create_indexing_task, create_index_check, create_backlink_check, read-only plan_retry, and local get_retry_history. Index-check and backlink-check reservations require operator-selected profiles and are not provider fees. Writes default off; pure previews require no key/state, and submissions need explicit private policy and existing V1 or V2 state. Three further public tools (submit_retry, compare_reports, summarize_campaigns) and one-shot retry execution remain roadmap work. Source implementation is not release or delivery evidence. No npm release is published.

plan_retry accepts only an optional Google/Yandex searchEngine, default Google. It requires matching enabled private configuration/retry and existing complete V2 state. Its strict ready/no_source/blocked/error outcomes carry identical JSON text and structured content; application isError is true exactly for error. The complete application envelope, including escaped text, duplicate structured data and isError, is bounded inclusively to 2,097,152 UTF-8 bytes, excluding SDK framing. Ready is a comparison proposal, with no jobs, reservations, adoption or paid authority. Selected-key local history and two non-atomic provider passes do not prove provider-wide coverage or fresh indexing truth. External observed corpora need explicit private permission and retain unknown original ancestry. Logical read-only permits physical WAL/SHM bookkeeping. Native close/final freshness precede owner completion; synchronous work can delay cancellation and SDK cancellation may suppress its reply. Public retry submission and scheduling remain future work.

get_retry_history reads recorded selected-key local V2 retry contexts without HTTP or logical writes. Its strict optional engine/parent/state/limit/cursor input defaults to both Google/Yandex and 25 entries; parent requires an exact engine/ID and cursors bind query/limit/revision. The existing CLI loader needs matching enabled configuration, while retry permission may be absent or disabled. Preserve nullable discarded terminal metadata, unknown ancestry/inception/provider-wide coverage, complete selected-key validation before pagination, existing-state/no-auto-init/migration, fixed ok/blocked/error outcomes and the same inclusive 2 MiB application envelope bound. The owner settles native reads and budget before reuse; SDK cancellation may suppress the response. Comparison refs grant no paid authority.

Backlink checks preserve 1 to 50 safe target strings (up to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes each), including case, order and duplicates. Submit needs enabled configuration, explicit backlink permission and a complete private three-unit profile. The local token floor is 2 per donor; other fees and target-count effects are unknown. All three create tools share donor-wide V1/V2 holds and caps. See README for policy validity, exact-body identity and restart/replay limits.
